hypothesis: Positive sampled executed BTC TWAP base flow over the preceding 15 minutes predicts a positive subsequent 15-minute fully funded spot long return after assumed costs.
design: One predeclared prospective hypothesis and price-momentum control; no performance-selected wallets, threshold tuning or historical signal backfill.
source: Native Hyperliquid userTwapSliceFills, the existing two frozen cohorts deduplicated into 22 public accounts.
funding: Zero by instrument definition: fully funded long/flat spot, no leverage, borrowing or perpetuals.
strategy: Long if the signed sum of eligible, deduplicated BTC slice base sizes is strictly positive; otherwise valid flat.
control: Long if current recorded spot midpoint exceeds the recorded midpoint 15 minutes earlier; otherwise valid flat.
decision_timing: First completed source batch in each UTC quarter-hour, after coverage warmup. An abstention consumes the bucket. At most one paired entry/outcome can be pending; no retroactive decisions.
price_references: First valid recorded bid/ask whose event and receipt follow the entry/exit due time, within 30 seconds. Entry ask and exit bid with displayed size gate; quotes are not guaranteed fills.
bootstrap: First response per account seeds historical IDs. Those fills never become eligible signals. New fills retain immutable first receipt; event time must be after trial start.
source_gates: All frozen accounts successful; 15 minutes of contiguous observed polls; actual ID overlap between nonempty histories; capped responses must reach the feature-window start; late/conflicting/future fills and stale/crossed/undersized quotes remain unknown.
accounting: Fixed-notional nonoverlapping paired event study, not a funded portfolio NAV. Quote spread, assumed slippage and entry/exit fees are charged. Unknown active outcomes are not zero returns and block readiness for review.
promotion: Never automatic. Meeting sample thresholds only permits further review; it does not validate alpha or enable orders.
limits: Sampled accounts are not independent owners or the whole market. Recent-list source coverage is inferred under the vendor contract, not venue-wide completeness. Parent TWAP remaining size/cancellation and external hedges are unknown.
